capabilities: Run Feynman explain loops that score your explanations and find gaps
Quiz with multiple-choice, short-answer and spot-the-error questions
Schedule concept review with SM-2 spaced repetition and a mistakes log
Extract text from PDFs with page citations and page-range splitting
Save re-teaching lessons as notes in the vault
extras: Desktop-only because it runs the claude/codex CLI as child processes; older Obsidian versions (1.8.7-1.12) get version 0.1.3. Discloses that note text and answers are sent to Anthropic/OpenAI, lists vault file paths, is not affiliated with Anthropic, and release files carry build provenance attestations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to study vault notes and PDFs by explaining them to an AI tutor that finds gaps, re-teaches and quizzes you.

relations.evidence: Claude runs through your Claude Code login, so your Pro/Max subscription works and you don't need an API key.
You can use OpenAI's models through the Codex CLI instead.

requires.name: Claude Code CLI installed and logged in (or Codex CLI for OpenAI models)
Anthropic subscription (Pro/Max) or API billing, or ChatGPT plan / OpenAI API key
poppler (pdftotext) for best PDF text extraction

summary: AI tutor that teaches your notes and PDFs with the Feynman technique through Claude Code or Codex CLI, with quizzes, misconception logging and spaced repetition.
